Class ReticulitermesFlavipes

java.lang.Object
org.swarmforge.core.species.CustomSpecies
org.swarmforge.core.species.ReticulitermesFlavipes
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Species
public class ReticulitermesFlavipes extends CustomSpecies
Reticulitermes flavipes - Eastern Subterranean Termite Subterranean eusocial insect, builds shelter tubes from soil and fecal cement, feeds on cellulose. Refactored to extend CustomSpecies for full JSON invalid input: '&' Species Editor parameter compatibility.

Silvère Martin-Michiellot, Gemini AI Assistant
